## Selected Engineering Case Studies
- [LLM Evaluation Platform](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/llm-evaluation-platform): Automated evaluation platform scoring prompt variations and model outputs with deterministic and statistical metrics.
- [Governed MCP Registry](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/governed-mcp-registry): High-throughput Model Context Protocol server registry with dynamic tool resolution and fine-grained access policies.
- [Code Intelligence Gateway](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/code-intelligence-gateway): Low-latency streaming proxy providing AST-aware code navigation and intelligent cache invalidation.
- [Knowledge Graph RAG](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/knowledge-graph-rag): Hybrid retrieval engine linking entity-relationship subgraphs with dense vector search for accurate query synthesis.
- [OmniGateway AI Proxy](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/omni-gateway): High-throughput AI API gateway featuring provider load balancing, semantic caching, and unified OpenTelemetry tracing.
- [CodeForge Autonomous Web Builder](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/codeforge): Full-stack SaaS platform transforming natural language specifications into running web apps with container sandbox isolation.
- [Serenify Mindful Assistant](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/serenify): Context-aware conversational wellness platform with mood journaling and privacy-first personalization.
